item.name: Check: patient1 has a patient profile

exec: pm.test('patient1 has a patient profile. If this fails run: python manage.py seed', ()=>{ const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(j) && j.length === 1).to.eql(true); });try { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('onco_patient_id', String(j[0].id)); } catch (e) {}

pm.test('doctor profile exists. If this fails run: python manage.py seed', ()=>{ const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(j) && j.length > 0).to.eql(true); });try { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('onco_doctor_id', String((j.find(d => d.is_me) || j[0]).id)); } catch (e) {}
